create_PNNColumn: create a PNNColumn neural network module with configurable input, output dimensions, hidden size, and activation function
create_PNNAction: create a PNNAction agent that extends CRLAgent with progressive neural network columns for continual learning
run_PNNAction_forward: run the PNNAction forward pass to compute actions and log probabilities for the current task
run_PNNColumn_forward: run the PNNColumn forward pass to process input through column weights and lateral connections
call_PNNAction_set_task: call set_task on PNNAction to freeze the last column and append a new column for a new task
